ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Four vials were set up to investigate bacterial transformation. Vials 1 and 2 each contained E. coli bacteria that had been made competent and had then been mixed with a plasmid containing the gene for ampicillin (pAMP) resistance. Vials 3 and 4 both contained E. coli that had also been made competent but had not been mixed with a plasmid. Each vial of bacteria was poured onto a nutrient agar plate. Vials 1 and 3 were poured onto plates that contained the antibiotic ampicillin. Vials 2 and 4 were poured onto plates that did not contain ampicillin. In a variant of this experiment, the plasmid contained GFP (green fluorescent protein) in addition to ampicillin resistance. Which plate would have the highest percentage of bacteria that would fluoresce? Answer with the plate number or plate label.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are four Petri dishes, labeled from left to right as “From test tube 1,” “From test tube 2,” “From test tube 3,” and “From test tube 4,” with the numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4 below them. Plate 1 has scattered colony dots; plate 2 shows overall growth; plate 3 appears to have no colonies or growth; plate 4 shows overall growth. Then reason: According to the question stem, the E. coli in vials 1 and 2 were mixed with a plasmid containing an ampicillin resistance gene; vials 3 and 4 were not mixed with the plasmid. 1 and 3 were poured onto plates containing ampicillin; 2 and 4 were poured onto plates without ampicillin. In the variant experiment, GFP and ampicillin resistance are located on the same plasmid, so only bacteria that were successfully transformed and carry that plasmid will fluoresce. Plate 1 has both plasmid treatment and ampicillin selection; non-transformed bacteria will be killed by the antibiotic, and the colonies that can grow should mainly be plasmid-bearing, GFP-positive bacteria, so the percentage of fluorescent bacteria is highest. Although plate 2 has plasmid treatment, it has no antibiotic screening, so untransformed, non-fluorescent bacteria can also grow; plates 3 and 4 have no plasmid and should not have GFP.

method.method_draft: First describe the image layout: four plates numbered 1 through 4, with plate 1 showing colonies, plate 2 and 4 showing growth, and plate 3 showing no growth. From the text, make a table: vials 1 and 2 received the plasmid; vials 3 and 4 did not. Plates 1 and 3 contain ampicillin; plates 2 and 4 do not. In the GFP variant, GFP is carried on the same plasmid as ampicillin resistance. Therefore, on plate 1, ampicillin kills nontransformed cells and the visible survivors should be plasmid-bearing GFP-positive cells, giving the highest fraction of fluorescent bacteria. Plate 2 has no antibiotic, so nontransformed nonfluorescent cells can also grow; plates 3 and 4 lack plasmid. Answer: plate 1.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有四个培养皿，从左到右分别标为“From test tube 1”“From test tube 2”“From test tube 3”“From test tube 4”，下方编号为1、2、3、4。1号板上有分散的菌落点；2号板显示有整体生长；3号板看起来没有菌落或生长；4号板显示有整体生长。

再推理：根据题干，1号和2号小瓶的E. coli被混入含有氨苄青霉素抗性基因的质粒；3号和4号没有混入质粒。1号和3号倒在含氨苄青霉素的平板上；2号和4号倒在不含氨苄青霉素的平板上。在变体实验中，GFP与氨苄青霉素抗性位于同一个质粒上，所以只有成功转化、带有该质粒的细菌才会发荧光。1号板既有质粒处理又有氨苄青霉素选择，非转化细菌会被抗生素杀死，能长出的菌落应主要是带质粒、GFP阳性的细菌，因此荧光细菌的百分比最高。2号板虽有质粒处理但无抗生素筛选，未转化、不发荧光的细菌也能生长；3号和4号没有质粒，不应有GFP。
